note: Names the rules profile and the drawings of this project, so no project name sits in the Python files. Paths are relative to the repo root, except inputRoot, which is the folder of the real input files on this machine. schedules names the two past schedule workbooks that the level proof reads from the References folder under inputRoot. drawings holds one file name per role. baseplan has the plot faces and labels. masterplan is the current master plan drawing, the second source check reads it and config/second_source.json names its plot layers. previousMasterplan is the master plan it replaced, kept for reference and not read in the full run. villaBlocks is the drawing the villa block of each unit is read from. roadLayout is the road layout drawing, its road edges give the front of a row. xrefRoles maps the name of an xref file that is not on disk to the role of the drawing that stands in for it. skip lists the other drawings the full run does not read, each with its reason. The analysis block holds how the CAD analysis reads the drawings. Lengths are in metres. partyWallShare is the share of plot.long_side that a shared edge must reach to count as a party wall. endShare is how far from the centre of a row, as a share of plot.long_side, a shared edge must lie to count as the front or the back of the row. roadEdgeLayers names the layers of the road layout drawing that hold the road edge polylines. unitPlotTypes lists the client plot types of the baseplan labels that stand for a plot with a unit on it, so only those plots get an issue when no unit code is found for them (R69). It is a list of plot types and never maps a plot type to a unit code (R30). noRev6Match lists the cluster codes of the profile that are old client codes with no Rev 6 cluster, and every cluster written with one of them gets an issue (R75). blockClusters maps the name of a footprint block to the cluster code it hints at, a block that stands for 2 or 4 plots says those plots are one cluster and it never gives a unit code to a plot (R90). The unit code of a plot is its Excel unit and nothing else (R69). pairRule false keeps the mirror flags of the blocks out of the row split until the original and mirror convention is known (R70). pastJob names what python/plan_from_past.py reads to build plan.json from a past job (R81). schedule is one of schedules and sheet is its sheet. prototypes is the full path of a kept copy of the prototypes.json the Revit reader wrote on the past model, since a later reader run writes prototypes.json again. prototypeFolder is the folder of the KEO prototype files under inputRoot, the Revit 2021 files of the past job, kept as the source. upgradedPrototypeFolder is the folder of their Revit 2024 copies with the same file names (R109), the folder plan.json gives the placer. output is the full path of the plan file, outside the repo. parameters lists the shared parameters to write on each link, RRE_ZZ_SP_Prototype-FFL is never one of them. testHost names what the Revit test host of R103 runs on. model is the site model under inputRoot that each run copies to <name>_TEST-<code>.rvt next to it, by a file copy only, and order is the prototype codes in the order they are tested, one per run. pastJob.baseplanPlots is plots.json of the CAD reader run on the baseplan, relative to the repo root, and its plot faces give each yard floor its plot (R111). floors names what the floor step of the placer places (R112 to R116). types gives the floor type names of each kind, generic, yard and ramp, and the plan builder, the placer and the check use only these. levels gives the level of each kind. plotParameter is the floor parameter that holds unit-plot, for example VD2-2441, on all three kinds. yardBelowFflM is how far the top of the yard sits below the FFL (Bader, 24 Oct). yardShareTie is the share difference under which two plots tie for one yard. yardMinShare is the least share the best face must hold, under it the yard goes to no plot and is listed (round 15b review). cadLinks holds what the links from CAD are measured with (R120 to R123). cutShareMin is the share of its Generic floor that the baseplan face of a plot must hold, a plot under it does not follow the baseplan cut and is listed apart in every comparison (R120). cutNeighbours lists the plots Bader added to the cut plots, the neighbours of the listed plots whose links or ramps follow the past cut of those plots, and they are listed apart with them (R120). caseParameters names the link parameters the CASE test of R132 compares the second letter with. floorWidthStepM is the step the plot width is rounded to when the Generic and yard outlines are grouped (R135). planOutput is the full path of the plan python/plan_from_cad.py writes, outside the repo next to the plan of the past job (R128).
